test_title: PYST 59: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
'A x B' means 'A is the husband of B'

'A + B' means 'A is the brother of B'

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the sister of B'

'A - B' means 'A is the wife of B'

How is X related to A in the expression 'X + Y ÷ Z - A'?

Given: X + Y ÷ Z - A

X + Y → X is the brother of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee1c4b584ef00212d18c46606b94e99c872fc144c872c89921b5ec52edf58753.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcc4f1836fcbd0fe34e75ad2d787e3c16305f75e5d7146d6acefd8c8f7a3e4fd.png] 

Y ÷ Z → Y is the sister of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/663a762379e3a72d9b44fb8c365da8afe7dbdeee449aaa4a63aea2a08e970034.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38226f681663fe0301730b3d069088f257b693cdbed04efbcc3a9b4dd898545a.png] 

Z - A → Z is the wife of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/235eb2411e478b6697502294c65380c1578eef8cf96d551e7097a1594c459918.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fd3d1aa0638419d42fe125fee28ee93b7e2399bed671b4b199c9cf32c9a72d7.png] 

Thus, X is the brother-in-law or wife's brother of A.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
